answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the beacon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the trellis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the tundra of the next round.
